independent_readback_recomputes: all original artifact and producer identities
unchanged pre-observer eligibility and all 120 exposure identities
all 5*N predeclared slot identities and consumption, at most 600
every actual raw return and exact empty proof
all existing five-valid nonempty admission decisions
unchanged source minima and family counts
complete_denominator_and_readback.report_partition: For a complete nonfatal panel: 120 originals = pre-observer rejected (120-N) + quarantined invalid-empty + five-valid but unqualified + qualified. The last three strata sum to N. Report attempted/returned/valid/empty/fatal/unknown separately for every required slot among the 5*N; never classify unplanned pre-observer rejects as missing returns.
complete_denominator_and_readback.retain_native_call_slot_denominator: 5*N exact preplanned slots; report the 600 maximum separately
complete_denominator_and_readback.retain_observer_eligible_denominator: N per provider, fixed before observation

fixed_plan.all_remaining_unknown_or_unstarted_slots: Any unknown or unstarted required slot among the predeclared 5*N keeps the panel closed; the 120-N pre-observer rejects were never planned calls.
fixed_plan.observer_eligible_originals: N = exactly the unchanged source owner's 96 synthetic plus pre-observer-eligible natural originals; 96 <= N <= 120, frozen before any observer.
fixed_plan.planned_native_call_slots_per_panel: 5*N, fixed before any native observation, at most 600
fixed_plan.pre_observer_rejected_natural_originals: All 120 exposure identities remain retained. The 120-N natural originals rejected by the existing pre-observer rule receive no native calls, no replacements and no empty-return classification.
fixed_plan.replication_opener: Only complete authenticated numerical PASS of this new primary; use the prospectively frozen untouched replica with identical weights and this same prospective policy.

native_empty_boundary.empty_predicate: Original selected native text has zero codepoints or every codepoint is in the frozen explicit White_Space set, after successful strict decoding and the original length/control checks.
parakeet_additional_proof: Original fixed command, model/runtime identity, environment, complete input, STARTED and RETURNED receipts agree.
Process actually started and returned exit code 0; no timeout, exception or unknown consumption.
Complete native stdout and stderr are preserved without transforms; the exact successful-return evidence is independently reopened.
native_empty_boundary.phone_provider_rule: XLSR/LV60 retain the complete finite nonempty native logits matrix, exact vocabulary, shape, frame coverage and original parser. Empty greedy token sequences are not empty native payloads. Missing, zero-byte, malformed or nonfinite matrices remain fatal.
native_empty_boundary.qwen_additional_proof: Original native envelope is a list of exactly one native result whose text field is a string; preserve the original envelope and its exact UTF-8 text. An empty list, missing field or non-string value is fatal.
native_empty_boundary.whisper_additional_proof: Original native envelope is a dict with a present string text field; preserve the original envelope and its exact UTF-8 text. A missing field, None or non-string value is fatal.

quarantine_rule.unit: One immutable original ID and PCM, not a selected provider response and not an entire person.

return_dispositions.condition: Every one of the five original native payloads is valid; ASR text is nonempty and phone tensors are complete finite nonempty matrices.
return_dispositions.panel_action: Continue the fixed plan; eligibility alone does not assign a class or pass a source minimum.

return_dispositions.condition: At least one ASR return satisfies every exact successful-empty proof requirement, and no fatal condition exists.
return_dispositions.panel_action: Keep the entire original out of all admission and KWS; continue every remaining preplanned call once.

return_dispositions.condition: A nonempty return fails its original parser, envelope, Unicode, shape, identity, hash, coverage or numeric validation.
return_dispositions.panel_action: SOURCE_STOP; no admitted subset can rescue this panel.

return_dispositions.condition: Timeout, exception, nonzero process exit, missing/partial raw data, unknown consumption, model initialization failure, duplicate or unplanned call, or incomplete required ledger.
return_dispositions.panel_action: SOURCE_STOP; no replay, replacement, resume, inference of empty, or KWS opening.
